title: Missing fragment cache for stable Rails content
summary: Stable page sections are recomputed for every Rails request.
rationale: Repeated rendering and query work wastes CPU when content changes less often than it is read.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Add fragment caching with explicit keys and invalidation boundaries.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
